newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Abdullah lays foundation stone for 1.2 billion riyal Shuaiba water project.
- Saudi Arabia to spend $11 billion on education this year, education minister says.
- Saudi investor Prince Al-Waleed plans to invest in Eritrea.
- Agriculture and water ministry plans projects worth 16 billion riyals for the next decade.
- Agriculture and water minister says Saudi is the world's biggest producer of desalinated water.
